server_instruction: Use the selected TV shown by list_tvs. Mutations need a fresh server epoch, explicit target and a unique operation key per user intent. A receipt means accepted, not that the TV changed. Look up a lost result with the same key; never auto-repeat an uncertain action. Pairing and forgetting require explicit target confirmation.

shared_mutation_fields.operation_key: UUID generated once for this user intent

tools.name: list_tvs
tools.description: List saved TVs, selected TV, epoch and generation; no TV network access.

tools.name: inspect_tv
tools.description: Inspect saved TV configuration and connection facts; no physical state claim.

tools.name: discover_tvs
tools.description: Discover local Samsung TVs; returns expiring candidate IDs.

tools.name: probe_tv
tools.description: Probe exactly one candidate ID or validated local host to observe the full certificate fingerprint before pairing.

tools.name: pair_tv
tools.description: Pair or re-pair only after confirming one fresh observation and exact full fingerprint; TV approval is still required.

tools.name: select_tv
tools.description: Select a saved TV for every client; requires the generation you observed.

tools.name: connect_tv
tools.description: Connect to the selected saved TV; reports remote readiness, not power.

tools.name: set_wake
tools.description: Set wired or Wi-Fi Wake MAC and active interface for a saved TV; checks its config revision.

tools.name: remote_action
tools.description: Send one semantic remote action to the selected TV; written means socket write only; PowerToggle may probe then Wake.

tools.name: wake_tv
tools.description: Send at most one Wake packet to the selected TV, then observe remote readiness separately.

tools.name: cancel_wake
tools.description: Stop a named Wake operation's reconnect wait; a packet already sent cannot be recalled.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Look up a lost receipt or terminal result by exactly one operation ID or key; optional wait up to 10 seconds never repeats the effect.

tools.name: forget_tv
tools.description: Forget a saved TV and its credentials only with exact device ID confirmation; partial cleanup stays blocked.

probe.next: Confirm the full fingerprint and TV before pair_tv.

pair_receipt.next: Approve on the TV, then get_operation.

written.meaning: Socket write only; TV state unobserved.

stale.next: Read current selection; do not retry automatically.

uncertain.next: The TV may have received it. Ask before another action.

forget.next: Resolve Keychain access; do not claim complete removal.

wake.next: Packet send does not prove power on.
